UGA.note: A 'Digital Transformation Agenda 2030' is named in passing by a district IT officer; its adoption and scope are not stated.
The district website template gives information (news, tenders, notices) and no online transaction is stated.

facts.fact: The Oyam District IT officer told the Daily Monitor that some districts are still not connected to the national backbone infrastructure, implying other districts are.
NITA-U's James Lutalo said NITA-U has developed a new district local government website template, replacing an older version, and NITA-U is training IT officers from 145 districts to manage it.
NITA-U provides the website template to district local governments and plans to extend it to municipal and town councils.

UGA.note: Districts off the national backbone are mentioned without a count or any statement that offices are connected.
